conclusion: The stage5-in-MuJoCo blocker is precisely the visual domain gap: the policy's arrival/stop behavior fires only on the Isaac appearance+dynamics visual stream (all three policy cameras, temporally coherent). MuJoCo's renders, even after appearance/marker/FOV/statistics corrections, do not cross the policy's recognition threshold. All nonvisual contracts (obs surface, action warp, locomotion, camera timing, age normalization) are verified closed.
